<script src="https://code.iconify.design/iconify-icon/1.0.7/iconify-icon.min.js"></script>
<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        // --- Dropdown Toggle ---
        const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-menu .dropdown > a');
        dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
            dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();

                const parentLi = dropdown.parentElement;
                const submenu = parentLi.querySelector(':scope > .sidebar-submenu');

                if (!submenu) return;

                const isOpen = submenu.style.display === 'block';

                const parentUl = parentLi.parentElement;
                if (parentUl) {
                    parentUl.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(li => {
                        if (li !== parentLi) {
                            const sm = li.querySelector(':scope > .sidebar-submenu');
                            if (sm) {
                                sm.style.display = 'none';
                                li.classList.remove('open');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }

                submenu.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
                parentLi.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
            });
        });

        // Prevent submenu clicks from closing the menu
        document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-submenu').forEach(submenu => {
            submenu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
            });
        });

        // --- Sidebar Search Filter ---
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('sidebar-search-input');
        const sidebarMenu = document.getElementById('sidebar-menu');
        const allMenuItems = sidebarMenu.querySelectorAll('li');

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();

            allMenuItems.forEach(li => {
                const link = li.querySelector('a');
                if (!link) return;

                const linkTextElement = link.querySelector('span');
                const linkText = linkTextElement ? linkTextElement.textContent.toLowerCase() : link.textContent.toLowerCase();

                let isMatch = linkText.includes(query);
                let hasVisibleChild = false;

                const isSubmenuItem = li.parentElement.classList.contains('sidebar-submenu');

                if (isSubmenuItem) {
                    li.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
                } else {
                    if (li.classList.contains('dropdown')) {
                        const submenuItems = li.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-submenu li');
                        submenuItems.forEach(subLi => {
                            const subLink = subLi.querySelector('a');
                            if (subLink) {
                                const subLinkTextElement = subLink.querySelector('span');
                                const subLinkText = subLinkTextElement ? subLinkTextElement.textContent.toLowerCase() : subLink.textContent.toLowerCase();

                                if (subLinkText.includes(query)) {
                                    hasVisibleChild = true;
                                    subLi.style.display = '';
                                } else {
                                    subLi.style.display = 'none';
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        const submenu = li.querySelector('.sidebar-submenu');
                        if (submenu) {
                            submenu.style.display = (hasVisibleChild || isMatch) && query !== '' ? 'block' : 'none';
                        }
                    }

                    isMatch = isMatch || hasVisibleChild;
                    li.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
                }
            });

            if (query === '') {
                allMenuItems.forEach(li => {
                    li.style.display = '';
                    if (li.classList.contains('dropdown')) {
                        const submenu = li.querySelector('.sidebar-submenu');
                        if (submenu) {
                            submenu.style.display = 'none';
                            li.classList.remove('open');
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    });
</script>

// State Store for Departures & Hotel Display
var partnerDeparturesData = {
    selectedCity: 'All',
    rawItems: [],
    groupedItems: [],
    searchTimeout: null,
    displayHotelsCache: null,
    activeTierForHotels: 'Bronze'
};

// Helper: Move all departures modals directly under <body> to prevent stacking context bugs
function moveDepartureModalsToBody() {
    var modalIds = [
        'partnerDeparturesModal',
        'hotelDisplayMasterModal',
        'departurePackageRatesModal',
        'departurePackageDetailsModal',
        'flightDetailsModal'
    ];
    modalIds.forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el && el.parentElement !== document.body) {
            document.body.appendChild(el);
        }
    });
}

// Execute immediately and on DOMContentLoaded
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', moveDepartureModalsToBody);
} else {
    moveDepartureModalsToBody();
}

// Helper: Get or initialize Bootstrap 5 modal safely
function getBsModalInstance(modalEl) {
    if (!modalEl) return null;
    if (typeof bootstrap !== 'undefined' && bootstrap.Modal) {
        return bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalEl) || new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl, {
            backdrop: true,
            keyboard: true
        });
    }
    return null;
}

// Departure modals: safe stacking & backdrop handling (isolated strictly to departure modals)
document.addEventListener('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = event.target;
    var stackedDepartureModals = [
        'hotelDisplayMasterModal',
        'departurePackageRatesModal',
        'flightDetailsModal',
        'departurePackageDetailsModal'
    ];
    if (modal && stackedDepartureModals.indexOf(modal.id) !== -1) {
        var computedZ = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(modal).zIndex) || 1065;
        setTimeout(function() {
            var backdrops = document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop');
            if (backdrops.length > 1) {
                var topBackdrop = backdrops[backdrops.length - 1];
                topBackdrop.style.zIndex = (computedZ - 5);
            }
        }, 10);
    }
});

document.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = event.target;
    var allDepartureModals = [
        'partnerDeparturesModal',
        'hotelDisplayMasterModal',
        'departurePackageRatesModal',
        'flightDetailsModal',
        'departurePackageDetailsModal'
    ];
    // ONLY run cleanup if the modal being hidden is one of the departure modals
    if (modal && allDepartureModals.indexOf(modal.id) !== -1) {
        var openModals = document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show');
        if (openModals.length > 0) {
            document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
        } else {
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show').length === 0) {
                    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
                    document.body.style.removeProperty('overflow');
                    document.body.style.removeProperty('padding-right');
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    }
});

// 1. Open Departures Modal
function openDeparturesModal() {
    moveDepartureModalsToBody();
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('partnerDeparturesModal');
    if (!modalEl) return;

    // Remove any leftover backdrops if no other modal is currently active
    if (!document.querySelector('.modal.show')) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach(function(b) { b.remove(); });
        document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
    }

    var bsModal = getBsModalInstance(modalEl);
    if (bsModal) {
        bsModal.show();
    } else if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && typeof $(modalEl).modal === 'function') {
        $(modalEl).modal('show');
    } else {
        modalEl.classList.add('show');
        modalEl.style.display = 'block';
        modalEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
        modalEl.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
        document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
    }

    if (partnerDeparturesData.rawItems.length === 0) {
        fetchDeparturesData();
    }
}

// 2. City Filter Tab Selection
function setDepartureCity(cityName) {
    partnerDeparturesData.selectedCity = cityName;

    document.querySelectorAll('.dep-city-pill').forEach(function(pill) {
        if (pill.getAttribute('data-city') === cityName) {
            pill.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            pill.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });

    fetchDeparturesData();
}

// 3. Debounce Search
function debounceDepSearch() {
    clearTimeout(partnerDeparturesData.searchTimeout);
    partnerDeparturesData.searchTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
        fetchDeparturesData();
    }, 300);
}

// 4. Reset Filters
function resetDepartureFilters() {
    document.getElementById('depFilterDateFrom').value = '';
    document.getElementById('depFilterDateTo').value = '';
    document.getElementById('depFilterMonth').value = '';
    document.getElementById('depFilterAirline').value = '';
    document.getElementById('depFilterSearch').value = '';
    document.getElementById('depFilterAvailableOnly').checked = true;
    setDepartureCity('All');
}

// 5. Fetch Departures from Backend API
function fetchDeparturesData() {
    var tableBody = document.getElementById('departuresTableBody');
    if (tableBody) {
        tableBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" class="py-5 text-center text-muted"><div class="spinner-border text-primary spinner-border-sm me-2"></div>Loading live departures...</td></tr>';
    }

    var city = partnerDeparturesData.selectedCity;
    var dateFrom = document.getElementById('depFilterDateFrom') ? document.getElementById('depFilterDateFrom').value : '';
    var dateTo = document.getElementById('depFilterDateTo') ? document.getElementById('depFilterDateTo').value : '';
    var month = document.getElementById('depFilterMonth') ? document.getElementById('depFilterMonth').value : '';
    var airline = document.getElementById('depFilterAirline') ? document.getElementById('depFilterAirline').value : '';
    var search = document.getElementById('depFilterSearch') ? document.getElementById('depFilterSearch').value : '';
    var availableOnly = (document.getElementById('depFilterAvailableOnly') && document.getElementById('depFilterAvailableOnly').checked) ? 1 : 0;

    var queryParams = new URLSearchParams({
        city: city,
        date_from: dateFrom,
        date_to: dateTo,
        month: month,
        airline: airline,
        search: search,
        available_only: availableOnly
    });

    fetch('ajax_get_departures.php?' + queryParams.toString())
        .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (!data.success) {
                if (tableBody) {
                    tableBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" class="py-4 text-center text-danger">Error: ' + (data.error || 'Failed to load departures') + '</td></tr>';
                }
                return;
            }

            partnerDeparturesData.rawItems = data.departures || [];
            partnerDeparturesData.groupedItems = data.grouped || [];

            var counterBadge = document.getElementById('depActiveCountBadge');
            if (counterBadge) {
                counterBadge.textContent = (data.count || 0) + ' Departures Found';
            }

            var summaryEl = document.getElementById('depResultSummaryText');
            if (summaryEl) {
                summaryEl.textContent = 'Showing ' + (data.count || 0) + ' confirmed fixed departures' + (city !== 'All' ? ' for ' + city : '');
            }

            if (data.airlines && data.airlines.length > 0) {
                var airlineSelect = document.getElementById('depFilterAirline');
                if (airlineSelect && airlineSelect.options.length <= 1) {
                    data.airlines.forEach(function(air) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = air;
                        opt.textContent = air;
                        airlineSelect.appendChild(opt);
                    });
                }
            }

            renderDeparturesTable(data.grouped || []);
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            console.error('Departures fetch error:', err);
            if (tableBody) {
                tableBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" class="py-4 text-center text-danger">Failed to load departure data. Please check connection.</td></tr>';
            }
        });
}

// 6. Format Number with Indian Comma Style
function formatPriceNum(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val) || val <= 0) return '-';
    return Number(val).toLocaleString('en-IN');
}

// 7. Render Departures Table
function renderDeparturesTable(groups) {
    var tableBody = document.getElementById('departuresTableBody');
    if (!tableBody) return;

    if (!groups || groups.length === 0) {
        tableBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" class="py-5 text-center text-muted"><iconify-icon icon="solar:box-minimalistic-broken" style="font-size:2.5rem;"></iconify-icon><div class="mt-2 fw-semibold">No departures found for the selected criteria.</div><small>Try selecting "All Cities" or clearing date filters.</small></td></tr>';
        return;
    }

    var html = '';

    groups.forEach(function(group) {
        // Month Group Header Banner matching screenshot
        html += '<tr class="month-header-row">';
        html += '<td colspan="10">' + escapeHtml(group.group_title) + '</td>';
        html += '</tr>';

        group.items.forEach(function(item) {
            html += '<tr>';

            // 1. Dep Date (Departure) - CLICKABLE: Loads Package Rates Modal!
            html += '<td class="text-start ps-3">';
            html += '<button type="button" class="dep-date-btn" onclick="openDepartureRatesModal(' + item.pnr_id + ', ' + item.package_id + ')" title="Click to view all rates for this departure">';
            html += '<iconify-icon icon="solar:calendar-bold" style="font-size:0.85rem;"></iconify-icon> ';
            html += escapeHtml(item.departure_date_formatted);
            html += '</button>';
            html += '</td>';

            // 2. Return Date (Return)
            html += '<td class="text-secondary text-start">' + escapeHtml(item.return_date_formatted) + '</td>';

            // 3. Airline (Carrier) - SHOW AIRLINE NAME! Clicking opens flight schedule & baggage modal
            html += '<td class="text-center">';
            html += '<button type="button" class="airline-name-trigger" onclick="openFlightDetailsModal(' + item.pnr_id + ')" title="Click to view flight schedule, terminals & baggage policy (' + escapeHtml(item.flight_name) + ')">';
            html += '<iconify-icon icon="solar:plane-bold" class="text-primary me-1.5"></iconify-icon>';
            html += '<span>' + escapeHtml(item.flight_name) + '</span>';
            html += '</button>';
            html += '</td>';

            // 4. Duration (Tour Length)
            html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(item.duration_display) + '</td>';

            // 5. Available Seats (Confirmed)
            var seatsClass = item.available_seats <= 3 ? 'text-danger fw-bold' : (item.available_seats <= 10 ? 'text-warning fw-bold' : 'text-dark fw-bold');
            html += '<td class="' + seatsClass + '">' + item.available_seats + ' Seats</td>';

            // 6. Respected Package Name - Clickable
            html += '<td class="text-start" style="max-width: 200px;">';
            if (item.package_id) {
                html += '<a href="javascript:void(0)" class="dep-package-link" onclick="openDepartureRatesModal(' + item.pnr_id + ', ' + item.package_id + ')" title="' + escapeHtml(item.package_name) + '">';
                html += escapeHtml(item.package_name);
                html += '</a>';
            } else {
                html += '<span class="text-muted small">' + escapeHtml(item.package_name) + '</span>';
            }
            html += '</td>';

            // 8. Budget Price (Sharing) - CLICKABLE: Loads Hotel Display Master for Budget Tier!
            html += '<td>';
            if (item.pricing && item.pricing.budget) {
                html += '<button type="button" class="dep-price-btn" onclick="openDisplayHotelsModal(\'Budget\', ' + item.pnr_id + ', ' + item.pricing.budget + ')" title="Click to view Budget Hotels list (/admin/hotel_display_master.php)">';
                html += formatPriceNum(item.pricing.budget);
                html += '</button>';
            } else {
                html += '<span class="dep-price-btn btn-na">-</span>';
            }
            html += '</td>';

            // 9. Bronze Price (Sharing) - CLICKABLE: Loads Hotel Display Master for Bronze Tier!
            html += '<td>';
            if (item.pricing && item.pricing.bronze) {
                html += '<button type="button" class="dep-price-btn" onclick="openDisplayHotelsModal(\'Bronze\', ' + item.pnr_id + ', ' + item.pricing.bronze + ')" title="Click to view Bronze Hotels list (/admin/hotel_display_master.php)">';
                html += formatPriceNum(item.pricing.bronze);
                html += '</button>';
            } else {
                html += '<span class="dep-price-btn btn-na">-</span>';
            }
            html += '</td>';

            // 10. Silver Price (Sharing) - CLICKABLE: Loads Hotel Display Master for Silver Tier!
            html += '<td>';
            if (item.pricing && item.pricing.silver) {
                html += '<button type="button" class="dep-price-btn" onclick="openDisplayHotelsModal(\'Silver\', ' + item.pnr_id + ', ' + item.pricing.silver + ')" title="Click to view Silver Hotels list (/admin/hotel_display_master.php)">';
                html += formatPriceNum(item.pricing.silver);
                html += '</button>';
            } else {
                html += '<span class="dep-price-btn btn-na">-</span>';
            }
            html += '</td>';

            // 11. Gold Price (Sharing) - CLICKABLE: Loads Hotel Display Master for Gold Tier!
            html += '<td>';
            if (item.pricing && item.pricing.gold) {
                html += '<button type="button" class="dep-price-btn" onclick="openDisplayHotelsModal(\'Gold\', ' + item.pnr_id + ', ' + item.pricing.gold + ')" title="Click to view Gold Hotels list (/admin/hotel_display_master.php)">';
                html += formatPriceNum(item.pricing.gold);
                html += '</button>';
            } else {
                html += '<span class="dep-price-btn btn-na">-</span>';
            }
            html += '</td>';

            html += '</tr>';
        });
    });

    tableBody.innerHTML = html;
}

// 7.5 HIGH-RESOLUTION IMAGE EXPORTER FOR DEPARTURES TABLE
// ========================================================
function loadHtml2CanvasIfNeeded(callback) {
    if (typeof html2canvas !== 'undefined') {
        callback();
        return;
    }
    var existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="html2canvas"]');
    if (existingScript) {
        existingScript.addEventListener('load', callback);
        return;
    }
    var script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js';
    script.onload = function() {
        callback();
    };
    script.onerror = function() {
        alert('Could not load image export library (html2canvas). Please ensure you have an active internet connection.');
    };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
}

            html2canvas(offscreenDiv, {
                scale: 2,
                useCORS: true,
                allowTaint: true,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                logging: false,
                windowWidth: 1400
            }).then(function(canvas) {
                var imageUri = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                var cleanAgency = agencyName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
                var fileName = cleanAgency + '_Live_Departures_' + (selectedCity ? selectedCity.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_') : 'All') + '_' + (new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)) + '.png';

                var downloadLink = document.createElement('a');
                downloadLink.download = fileName;
                downloadLink.href = imageUri;
                document.body.appendChild(downloadLink);
                downloadLink.click();
                document.body.removeChild(downloadLink);

                // Clean up offscreen container
                if (offscreenDiv.parentNode) {
                    offscreenDiv.parentNode.removeChild(offscreenDiv);
                }

                // Restore export buttons
                exportButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<iconify-icon icon="solar:check-circle-bold" class="text-success me-1"></iconify-icon> Downloaded!';
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        if (btn._originalHtml) btn.innerHTML = btn._originalHtml;
                    }, 3000);
                });
            }).catch(function(err) {
                console.error('Error generating departures image:', err);
                alert('Could not export table as image: ' + (err.message || err));
                if (offscreenDiv.parentNode) {
                    offscreenDiv.parentNode.removeChild(offscreenDiv);
                }
                exportButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    if (btn._originalHtml) btn.innerHTML = btn._originalHtml;
                });
            });

        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Export exception:', e);
            alert('Export failed: ' + e.message);
            exportButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                if (btn._originalHtml) btn.innerHTML = btn._originalHtml;
            });
        }
    });
}

// ========================================================
// 8. HOTEL DISPLAY MASTER MODAL CONTROLLER
// ========================================================
function openDisplayHotelsModal(tierName, pnrId, priceVal) {
    moveDepartureModalsToBody();
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('hotelDisplayMasterModal');
    if (!modalEl) return;

    partnerDeparturesData.activeTierForHotels = tierName || 'Bronze';

    var bsModal = getBsModalInstance(modalEl);
    if (bsModal) {
        bsModal.show();
    } else if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && typeof $(modalEl).modal === 'function') {
        $(modalEl).modal('show');
    } else {
        modalEl.classList.add('show');
        modalEl.style.display = 'block';
        modalEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
        modalEl.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    }

    // Update Context Ribbon
    var depItem = partnerDeparturesData.rawItems.find(function(it) { return it.pnr_id == pnrId; });
    var ribbon = document.getElementById('hotelModalContextRibbon');
    if (depItem) {
        ribbon.style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('hotelModalDepInfo').textContent = depItem.departure_date_formatted + ' | ' + depItem.flight_name + ' (' + depItem.city_name + ')';
        document.getElementById('hotelModalPriceBadge').textContent = tierName + ' Sharing: ₹' + formatPriceNum(priceVal);
    } else {
        ribbon.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Highlight Tier Pill
    highlightHotelTierTab(partnerDeparturesData.activeTierForHotels);

    // Fetch and render hotels
    loadHotelDisplayData(partnerDeparturesData.activeTierForHotels);
}

function selectHotelDisplayTier(tierName) {
    partnerDeparturesData.activeTierForHotels = tierName;
    highlightHotelTierTab(tierName);
    loadHotelDisplayData(tierName);
}

function highlightHotelTierTab(tierName) {
    document.getElementById('hotelModalTierNameTitle').textContent = tierName + ' Tier';
    document.querySelectorAll('#hotelDisplayTierTabs .tier-tab-pill').forEach(function(pill) {
        if (pill.getAttribute('data-tier') === tierName) {
            pill.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            pill.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });
}

function loadHotelDisplayData(tierName) {
    var makkahContainer = document.getElementById('makkahHotelsContainer');
    var madinaContainer = document.getElementById('madinaHotelsContainer');

    makkahContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted small"><div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-primary"></div> Loading Makkah hotels...</div>';
    madinaContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted small"><div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-primary"></div> Loading Madinah hotels...</div>';

    fetch('ajax_get_display_hotels.php?tier=' + encodeURIComponent(tierName))
        .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (!data.success || !data.data) {
                makkahContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted small">No Makkah hotels mapped for ' + escapeHtml(tierName) + ' tier.</div>';
                madinaContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted small">No Madinah hotels mapped for ' + escapeHtml(tierName) + ' tier.</div>';
                document.getElementById('makkahHotelCountBadge').textContent = '0 Hotels';
                document.getElementById('madinaHotelCountBadge').textContent = '0 Hotels';
                return;
            }

            // Case-insensitive key lookup
            var tierKey = Object.keys(data.data).find(function(k) {
                return k.toLowerCase() === tierName.toLowerCase();
            }) || tierName;

            var tierData = data.data[tierKey] || {};
            var makkahList = tierData.makkah || [];
            var madinaList = tierData.madina || [];

            document.getElementById('makkahHotelCountBadge').textContent = makkahList.length + ' Hotels';
            document.getElementById('madinaHotelCountBadge').textContent = madinaList.length + ' Hotels';

            // Render Makkah
            if (makkahList.length === 0) {
                makkahContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted small">No Makkah hotels listed for ' + escapeHtml(tierName) + ' tier.</div>';
            } else {
                var mHtml = '<div class="d-flex flex-column gap-2">';
                makkahList.forEach(function(h) {
                    mHtml += renderHotelMasterCard(h);
                });
                mHtml += '</div>';
                makkahContainer.innerHTML = mHtml;
            }

            // Render Madina
            if (madinaList.length === 0) {
                madinaContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted small">No Madinah hotels listed for ' + escapeHtml(tierName) + ' tier.</div>';
            } else {
                var mdHtml = '<div class="d-flex flex-column gap-2">';
                madinaList.forEach(function(h) {
                    mdHtml += renderHotelMasterCard(h);
                });
                mdHtml += '</div>';
                madinaContainer.innerHTML = mdHtml;
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            console.error('Hotel display fetch error:', err);
            makkahContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-3 text-danger small">Failed to load hotels.</div>';
            madinaContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-3 text-danger small">Failed to load hotels.</div>';
        });
}

function renderHotelMasterCard(h) {
    var loc = h.location_details || 'Standard Distance';
    var isBus = loc.toLowerCase().indexOf('bus') !== -1;
    var distBg = isBus ? 'bg-secondary text-white' : 'bg-primary-subtle text-primary border border-primary-subtle';
    var ytLink = (h.youtube_link || '').trim();

    var html = '<div class="hotel-master-card p-2.5 rounded-3 border bg-white shadow-sm">';
    html += '<div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between mb-1.5 flex-wrap gap-1">';
    html += '<span class="fw-bold text-dark fs-6">' + escapeHtml(h.hotel_name) + '</span>';
    html += '<span class="badge ' + distBg + ' fw-semibold" style="font-size:0.72rem; padding: 4px 8px;">';
    if (isBus) {
        html += '<iconify-icon icon="solar:bus-bold" class="me-1"></iconify-icon>';
    } else {
        html += '<iconify-icon icon="solar:walking-bold" class="me-1"></iconify-icon>';
    }
    html += escapeHtml(loc) + '</span>';
    html += '</div>';

    html += '<div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between pt-1.5 border-top flex-wrap gap-2">';
    html += '<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-1.5 text-muted small" style="font-size:0.75rem;">';
    html += '<iconify-icon icon="solar:map-point-bold" class="text-danger"></iconify-icon>';
    html += '<span>' + escapeHtml(h.city) + '</span>';
    if (h.regular_rates) {
        html += '<span class="text-secondary ms-1">| Rates: ' + escapeHtml(h.regular_rates) + '</span>';
    }
    html += '</div>';

    // YouTube Tour Link
    if (ytLink) {
        html += '<a href="' + escapeHtml(ytLink) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger py-1 px-3 rounded-pill d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-1.5 text-white fw-bold shadow-sm" style="font-size:0.75rem; text-decoration:none;" title="Watch Video Tour on YouTube">';
        html += '<iconify-icon icon="logos:youtube-icon" style="font-size:1.1rem; filter: brightness(1.2);"></iconify-icon>';
        html += '<span>Watch Video Tour</span>';
        html += '</a>';
    } else {
        html += '<span class="badge bg-light text-muted border px-2 py-1" style="font-size:0.7rem;">Verified Property</span>';
    }
    html += '</div>';

    html += '</div>';
    return html;
}

// 9. DEPARTURE PACKAGE RATES MODAL (On Click Date)
// ========================================================
function openDepartureRatesModal(pnrId, packageId) {
    if (!pnrId && !packageId) return;

    moveDepartureModalsToBody();
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('departurePackageRatesModal');
    if (!modalEl) return;

    var bsModal = getBsModalInstance(modalEl);
    if (bsModal) {
        bsModal.show();
    } else if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && typeof $(modalEl).modal === 'function') {
        $(modalEl).modal('show');
    } else {
        modalEl.classList.add('show');
        modalEl.style.display = 'block';
        modalEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
        modalEl.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    }

    var depItem = partnerDeparturesData.rawItems.find(function(it) { return it.pnr_id == pnrId; });
    var pkgIdToFetch = packageId || (depItem ? depItem.package_id : 0);

    // Initial info from cached item
    if (depItem) {
        document.getElementById('ratesModalPackageName').textContent = depItem.package_name;
        document.getElementById('ratesModalDepDates').textContent = 'Departure: ' + depItem.departure_date_formatted + ' to ' + depItem.return_date_formatted + ' | Tour Length: ' + depItem.duration_display;
        document.getElementById('ratesModalPnrBadge').textContent = 'PNR: ' + depItem.pnr_code;
        document.getElementById('ratesModalFlightInfo').textContent = 'Airline: ' + depItem.flight_name;
        document.getElementById('ratesModalCityInfo').textContent = 'Ex ' + depItem.city_name;
        document.getElementById('ratesModalSeatsBadge').textContent = depItem.available_seats + ' Seats Confirmed';
        document.getElementById('ratesModalDurationBadge').textContent = depItem.duration_display;
    }

    // Quick Overview Row
    var quickRow = document.getElementById('ratesOverviewQuickRow');
    if (depItem && depItem.pricing) {
        var qHtml = '';
        var quickTiers = [
            { key: 'budget', name: 'Budget Rate', subtitle: 'Saver', price: depItem.pricing.budget },
            { key: 'bronze', name: 'Bronze Rate', subtitle: 'Bronze', price: depItem.pricing.bronze },
            { key: 'silver', name: 'Silver Rate', subtitle: 'Silver', price: depItem.pricing.silver },
            { key: 'gold', name: 'Gold Rate', subtitle: 'Gold', price: depItem.pricing.gold }
        ];

        quickTiers.forEach(function(qt) {
            var formatted = qt.price ? '₹' + formatPriceNum(qt.price) : 'N/A';
            qHtml += '<div class="col-6 col-md-3">';
            qHtml += '<div class="p-2.5 rounded-3 bg-white border text-center shadow-sm">';
            qHtml += '<div class="text-muted small fw-semibold" style="font-size:0.75rem;">' + escapeHtml(qt.name) + '</div>';
            qHtml += '<div class="fw-bold text-dark fs-6 my-1">' + formatted + '</div>';
            qHtml += '<div class="text-secondary" style="font-size:0.7rem;">' + escapeHtml(qt.subtitle) + '</div>';
            qHtml += '</div>';
            qHtml += '</div>';
        });
        quickRow.innerHTML = qHtml;
    }

    // Detailed breakdown container
    var detailedContainer = document.getElementById('ratesDetailedTiersContainer');
    detailedContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4 text-muted"><div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-primary"></div> Loading full room sharing breakdown...</div>';

    // Hook View Full Details Button
    document.getElementById('ratesModalViewDetailsBtn').onclick = function() {
        openDeparturePackageModal(pkgIdToFetch, pnrId);
    };

    // Hook Book Button
    document.getElementById('ratesModalBookBtn').href = 'create-request-new.php?package_id=' + pkgIdToFetch + '&pnr_id=' + pnrId;

    // Fetch Full Package Data
    fetch('ajax_get_departure_package_details.php?package_id=' + pkgIdToFetch + '&pnr_id=' + pnrId)
        .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (!data.success) {
                detailedContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-danger py-3 text-center">Could not load detailed rates: ' + escapeHtml(data.error) + '</div>';
                return;
            }

            var tiers = data.tiers || [];
            if (tiers.length === 0) {
                detailedContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted py-3 text-center">No tiers configured for this package.</div>';
                return;
            }

            var dHtml = '<div class="d-flex flex-column gap-3">';

            tiers.forEach(function(tier) {
                var p = tier.pricing || {};
                var sharingPrice = p.sharing ? '₹' + formatPriceNum(p.sharing) : 'N/A';

                dHtml += '<div class="rate-tier-card">';
                dHtml += '<div class="rate-tier-header d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between flex-wrap gap-2">';
                dHtml += '<div>';
                dHtml += '<span class="text-primary fs-6 fw-bold">' + escapeHtml(tier.type_name) + '</span>';
                if (tier.subtitle) {
                    dHtml += ' <span class="text-muted small fw-normal">(' + escapeHtml(tier.subtitle) + ')</span>';
                }
                dHtml += '</div>';
                dHtml += '<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">';
                dHtml += '<span class="badge bg-primary fs-6 px-3 py-1.5">' + sharingPrice + ' <small class="fw-normal" style="font-size:0.7rem;">(Sharing)</small></span>';
                dHtml += '</div>';
                dHtml += '</div>';

                // Pricing Row Elements
                dHtml += '<div class="p-3 bg-white">';
                dHtml += '<div class="row g-2">';

                var roomTypes = [
                    { key: 'sharing', label: 'Sharing' },
                    { key: 'quint', label: 'Quint (5 Bed)' },
                    { key: 'quad', label: 'Quad (4 Bed)' },
                    { key: 'triple', label: 'Triple (3 Bed)' },
                    { key: 'double', label: 'Double (2 Bed)' },
                    { key: 'single', label: 'Single' },
                    { key: 'child_with_bed', label: 'Child With Bed' },
                    { key: 'child_without_bed', label: 'Child No Bed' },
                    { key: 'infant', label: 'Infant' }
                ];

                roomTypes.forEach(function(rt) {
                    var val = p[rt.key];
                    var formatted = (val && val > 0) ? '₹' + formatPriceNum(val) : 'N/A';
                    dHtml += '<div class="col-4 col-md-3 col-lg-2.4">';
                    dHtml += '<div class="price-item-box">';
                    dHtml += '<div class="label fw-bold text-dark" style="font-weight:800!important;font-size:0.86rem;color:#0f172a!important;">' + escapeHtml(rt.label) + '</div>';
                    dHtml += '<div class="amount fw-bold" style="' + (formatted === 'N/A' ? 'color:#94a3b8;font-size:0.85rem;' : 'color:#15803d;font-size:0.98rem;') + '">' + formatted + '</div>';
                    dHtml += '</div>';
                    dHtml += '</div>';
                });

                dHtml += '</div>'; // row
                dHtml += '</div>'; // p-3

                dHtml += '</div>'; // rate-tier-card
            });

            dHtml += '</div>';
            detailedContainer.innerHTML = dHtml;
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            console.error('Rates fetch error:', err);
            detailedContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-danger py-3 text-center">Failed to load detailed rates.</div>';
        });
}

// 10. FULL PACKAGE DETAILS MODAL (Inclusions & Policies)

function openDeparturePackageModal(packageId, pnrId) {
    if (!packageId) return;

    moveDepartureModalsToBody();
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('departurePackageDetailsModal');
    if (!modalEl) return;

    var bsModal = getBsModalInstance(modalEl);
    if (bsModal) {
        bsModal.show();
    } else if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && typeof $(modalEl).modal === 'function') {
        $(modalEl).modal('show');
    } else {
        modalEl.classList.add('show');
        modalEl.style.display = 'block';
        modalEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
        modalEl.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    }

    document.getElementById('pkgModalTitle').textContent = 'Loading Package Details...';

    fetch('ajax_get_departure_package_details.php?package_id=' + packageId + (pnrId ? '&pnr_id=' + pnrId : ''))
        .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (!data.success) {
                alert('Error loading package details: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error'));
                return;
            }
            var pkg = data.package;
            document.getElementById('pkgModalTitle').textContent = pkg.package_master_name;
            document.getElementById('pkgModalServiceBadge').textContent = (pkg.service || 'Umrah') + ' • ' + (pkg.umrah_type || 'Fixed Group');

            document.getElementById('pkgModalInclusions').textContent = pkg.inclusion || 'All standard services included.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalExclusions').textContent = pkg.exclusion || 'TCS, GST and personal expenses.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalItinerary').textContent = pkg.itinerary || 'Daily Ziyarat & program schedule will be provided upon arrival.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalTransport').textContent = pkg.flight_transport || 'Economy return flights & round trip AC bus transfers.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalVisa').textContent = pkg.visa_taxes || 'Single Entry Umrah Tourist / EVisa with comprehensive travel insurance.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalPaymentPolicy').textContent = pkg.payment_policy || 'Standard booking token required.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalCancellationPolicy').textContent = pkg.cancellation_policy || 'Standard group cancellation terms apply.';
            document.getElementById('pkgModalImportantNotes').textContent = pkg.important_notes || 'Rooms allotment strictly as per hotel management.';
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            console.error('Package details fetch error:', err);
            alert('Failed to load package details.');
        });
}

// ========================================================
// 11. FLIGHT DETAILS MODAL (Schedule, Terminals & Baggage)
// ========================================================
function formatAviationTimeHtml(time24, time12, fallbackGdsDigits) {
    var raw24 = (time24 || '').trim();
    var raw12 = (time12 || '').trim();

    // If 24h time is missing, try 4-digit GDS time (e.g. "1720" -> "17:20")
    if (!raw24 && fallbackGdsDigits && /^\d{4}$/.test(fallbackGdsDigits)) {
        raw24 = fallbackGdsDigits.slice(0, 2) + ':' + fallbackGdsDigits.slice(2);
    }

    // If still missing 24h but have 12h (e.g. "05:20 PM")
    if (!raw24 && raw12) {
        var m = raw12.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)?/i);
        if (m) {
            var h = parseInt(m[1], 10);
            var min = m[2];
            var ampm = (m[3] || '').toUpperCase();
            if (ampm === 'PM' && h < 12) h += 12;
            if (ampm === 'AM' && h === 12) h = 0;
            raw24 = (h < 10 ? '0' + h : h) + ':' + min;
        }
    }

    // If have 24h but missing 12h
    if (raw24 && !raw12) {
        var m2 = raw24.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
        if (m2) {
            var h2 = parseInt(m2[1], 10);
            var min2 = m2[2];
            var ampm2 = h2 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
            var h12_val = h2 % 12 || 12;
            raw12 = (h12_val < 10 ? '0' + h12_val : h12_val) + ':' + min2 + ' ' + ampm2;
        }
    }

    if (!raw24 && !raw12) {
        return '<span class="text-muted small">TBA</span>';
    }

    var fourDigits = raw24.replace(':', '');
    var html = '<div class="d-flex align-items-baseline gap-1.5 flex-wrap">';
    html += '<span class="fw-bolder fs-5 text-dark font-monospace">' + escapeHtml(raw24) + '</span>';
    html += '<span class="badge bg-primary text-white font-monospace" style="font-size:0.65rem; padding: 2px 5px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">' + escapeHtml(fourDigits) + ' HRS</span>';
    html += '</div>';
    if (raw12) {
        html += '<div class="text-secondary fw-semibold mt-0.5" style="font-size: 0.76rem;">' + escapeHtml(raw12) + '</div>';
    }
    return html;
}

function extractGdsTimesFromItinerary(itineraryStr) {
    var res = { obDep: '', obArr: '', retDep: '', retArr: '' };
    if (!itineraryStr) return res;
    var lines = itineraryStr.split(/\r?\n/).map(function(l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length >= 1) {
        // e.g. "QP 552 27OCT BOM JED HK40 1720 2045"
        var m1 = lines[0].match(/(\d{4})\s+(\d{4})/);
        if (m1) {
            res.obDep = m1[1];
            res.obArr = m1[2];
        }
    }
    if (lines.length >= 2) {
        // e.g. "QP 553 10NOV JED BOM HK40 2145 0525"
        var m2 = lines[1].match(/(\d{4})\s+(\d{4})/);
        if (m2) {
            res.retDep = m2[1];
            res.retArr = m2[2];
        }
    }
    return res;
}

function copyFlightModalPnr() {
    var pnrBadge = document.getElementById('flightModalPnrBadge');
    if (!pnrBadge) return;
    var pnrCode = (pnrBadge.textContent || '').replace('PNR:', '').trim();
    if (!pnrCode || pnrCode === '-') return;

    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(pnrCode);
    } else {
        var input = document.createElement('textarea');
        input.value = pnrCode;
        document.body.appendChild(input);
        input.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(input);
    }

    var orig = pnrBadge.textContent;
    pnrBadge.textContent = 'Copied: ' + pnrCode + '!';
    setTimeout(function() {
        pnrBadge.textContent = orig;
    }, 2000);
}

function copyFlightModalItinerary() {
    var itinEl = document.getElementById('flightModalItinerary');
    if (!itinEl) return;
    var text = (itinEl.textContent || '').trim();
    if (!text || text === '-') return;

    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    } else {
        var input = document.createElement('textarea');
        input.value = text;
        document.body.appendChild(input);
        input.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(input);
    }
    alert('Flight itinerary notes copied to clipboard!');
}

function openFlightDetailsModal(pnrId) {
    if (!pnrId) return;

    moveDepartureModalsToBody();
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('flightDetailsModal');
    if (!modalEl) return;

    var item = partnerDeparturesData.rawItems.find(function(it) { return it.pnr_id == pnrId; });
    if (!item) return;

    var bsModal = getBsModalInstance(modalEl);
    if (bsModal) {
        bsModal.show();
    } else if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && typeof $(modalEl).modal === 'function') {
        $(modalEl).modal('show');
    } else {
        modalEl.classList.add('show');
        modalEl.style.display = 'block';
        modalEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
        modalEl.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    }

    // Airline Logo & Name
    var logoImg = document.getElementById('flightModalAirlineLogo');
    var logoContainer = document.getElementById('flightModalLogoContainer');
    if (item.airline_logo) {
        logoImg.src = item.airline_logo;
        logoImg.alt = item.flight_name || 'Airline';
        logoContainer.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    } else {
        logoContainer.style.display = 'none';
    }

    document.getElementById('flightModalAirlineName').textContent = item.flight_name || 'Flight Schedule';
    document.getElementById('flightModalPnrBadge').textContent = 'PNR: ' + (item.pnr_code || 'N/A');
    
    var sectorDesc = (item.city_name || 'Departure') + ' • ' + (item.departure_sector || item.city_name) + ' to Saudi Arabia';
    document.getElementById('flightModalRouteSubtitle').innerHTML = '<iconify-icon icon="solar:route-bold" class="text-warning me-1"></iconify-icon>' + escapeHtml(sectorDesc);

    // Date range & meta
    document.getElementById('flightModalDateRange').textContent = item.departure_date_formatted + ' to ' + item.return_date_formatted;
    document.getElementById('flightModalTourLength').textContent = item.duration_display || (item.number_of_days + ' Days Tour');
    document.getElementById('flightModalFlightType').textContent = item.flight_type ? item.flight_type.toUpperCase() : 'DIRECT FLIGHT';

    // Parse GDS 4-digit times if available in itinerary text
    var gdsTimes = extractGdsTimesFromItinerary(item.itinerary);

    // Outbound Flight
    document.getElementById('flightModalOutboundFlightNo').textContent = item.departure_flight_number || (item.flight_name + ' Outbound');
    document.getElementById('flightModalOutboundSector').textContent = item.departure_sector || (item.city_name + ' ➔ JED');
    document.getElementById('flightModalOutboundDepTime').innerHTML = formatAviationTimeHtml(item.departure_time_24, item.departure_time, gdsTimes.obDep);
    document.getElementById('flightModalOutboundDepTerminal').textContent = item.india_departure_terminal ? ('Terminal: ' + item.india_departure_terminal) : 'Terminal: TBA';
    document.getElementById('flightModalOutboundArrTime').innerHTML = formatAviationTimeHtml(item.saudi_arrival_time_24, item.saudi_arrival_time, gdsTimes.obArr);
    document.getElementById('flightModalOutboundArrTerminal').textContent = item.saudi_arrival_terminal ? ('Terminal: ' + item.saudi_arrival_terminal) : 'Terminal: TBA';

    // Return Flight
    document.getElementById('flightModalReturnFlightNo').textContent = item.return_flight_number || (item.flight_name + ' Return');
    document.getElementById('flightModalReturnSector').textContent = item.return_sector || ('JED ➔ ' + item.city_name);
    document.getElementById('flightModalReturnDepTime').innerHTML = formatAviationTimeHtml(item.return_time_24, item.return_time, gdsTimes.retDep);
    document.getElementById('flightModalReturnDepTerminal').textContent = item.saudi_departure_terminal ? ('Terminal: ' + item.saudi_departure_terminal) : 'Terminal: TBA';
    document.getElementById('flightModalReturnArrTime').innerHTML = formatAviationTimeHtml(item.india_arrival_time_24, item.india_arrival_time, gdsTimes.retArr);
    document.getElementById('flightModalReturnArrTerminal').textContent = item.india_arrival_terminal ? ('Terminal: ' + item.india_arrival_terminal) : 'Terminal: TBA';

    // Baggage Policy & Highlight Badge
    var baggageTxt = (item.baggage_policy || '').trim();
    if (!baggageTxt) {
        baggageTxt = '25KG + ZAM ZAM + 07 KG (HAND CARRY)\nStandard group allowance as per carrier and Saudi civil aviation authority.';
    }
    
    // Extract first line as primary banner highlight
    var lines = baggageTxt.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
    var highlightTxt = lines[0] || '25KG + ZAM ZAM + 07 KG (HAND CARRY)';
    document.getElementById('flightModalBaggageHighlight').textContent = highlightTxt;
    document.getElementById('flightModalBaggagePolicy').textContent = baggageTxt;

    // Cancellation Policy & Itinerary
    document.getElementById('flightModalCancellationPolicy').textContent = item.cancellation_policy || 'NON-REFUNDABLE\nGroup departure ticket is strictly non-refundable and non-changeable once issued.';
    document.getElementById('flightModalItinerary').textContent = item.itinerary || 'Direct / group departure flight with dedicated airport assistance upon departure & arrival.';

    // Connect View Rates button
    var ratesBtn = document.getElementById('flightModalRatesBtn');
    if (ratesBtn) {
        ratesBtn.onclick = function() {
            var fModal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalEl);
            if (fModal) fModal.hide();
            openDepartureRatesModal(item.pnr_id, item.package_id);
        };
    }
}

// Utility: Escape HTML
function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}
