    <script>
    (function(){
        function aq$(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
        var aqCurrentQueryId = null;
        var aqStaffReplied = false;
        var aqRmInfo = { name:'', number:'', staff_id:0 };
        var aqPollTimer = null;
        var aqPrevPollTimer = null;

        function aqPost(action, data){
            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('action', action);
            for (var k in data) fd.append(k, data[k]);
            return fetch('agent_query_handler.php', { method:'POST', body:fd }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); });
        }

        window.aqToggle = function(){
            var l = aq$('aqLauncher'), p = aq$('aqCqPanel'), c = aq$('aqChat');
            if (!l) return;
            var anyOpen = l.classList.contains('show') || p.classList.contains('show') || c.classList.contains('show');
            if (anyOpen){ l.classList.remove('show'); p.classList.remove('show'); c.classList.remove('show'); }
            else { l.classList.add('show'); aqLoadRM(); }
        };
        var btn = aq$('aq-widget-btn');
        if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', aqToggle);

        window.aqShowCreatePanel = function(){
            aq$('aqLauncher').classList.remove('show');
            aq$('aqCqPanel').classList.add('show');
            aqLoadRM();
        };
        window.aqShowUmrahAI = function(){
            alert('Umrah AI assistant is coming soon. Please use Create Query to reach your manager.');
        };
        window.aqBackToLauncher = function(){
            aq$('aqCqPanel').classList.remove('show');
            aq$('aqLauncher').classList.add('show');
        };

        function aqLoadRM(){
            if (aqRmInfo.name) { aqRenderRM(); return; }
            aqPost('get_rm', {}).then(function(r){
                if (r.status==='success'){
                    aqRmInfo = { name:r.rm_name||'Manager', number:r.rm_number||'N/A', staff_id:r.staff_id||0 };
                } else {
                    aqRmInfo = { name:'Not Assigned', number:'N/A', staff_id:0 };
                }
                aqRenderRM();
            }).catch(function(){ aqRmInfo = { name:'Not Assigned', number:'N/A', staff_id:0 }; aqRenderRM(); });
        }
        function aqRenderRM(){
            aq$('aqRmName').textContent = aqRmInfo.name;
            aq$('aqRmNumText').textContent = aqRmInfo.number;
            aq$('aqRmAvatar').textContent = (aqRmInfo.name||'RM').split(' ').map(function(s){return s[0]||'';}).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
        }

        window.aqStartNewQuery = function(){
            // No DB row created yet. Row is created when the agent sends the first message.
            aqPost('create_query', {}).then(function(r){
                if (r.status==='success'){
                    aqCurrentQueryId = 0; // 0 means "not yet persisted"; first send will create it
                    aqStaffReplied = false;
                    aq$('aqCqPanel').classList.remove('show');
                    aq$('aqChat').classList.add('show');
                    aq$('aqChatTitle').textContent = 'New Query';
                    aq$('aqChatSub').textContent = 'To: ' + aqRmInfo.name;
                    aq$('aqChatAv').textContent = (aqRmInfo.name||'RM').split(' ').map(function(s){return s[0]||'';}).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
                    aq$('aqChatBody').innerHTML = '';
                    aq$('aqClosedBanner').classList.remove('show');
                    aq$('aqChatActions').classList.remove('show');
                    aq$('aqChatFoot').style.display = 'flex';
                    aqRenderMessages([], 'aqChatBody');
                    aqStartPolling();
                } else {
                    alert(r.message || 'Failed to start query');
                }
            }).catch(function(e){ alert('Network error'); });
        };

        window.aqMinChat = function(){ aq$('aqChat').classList.remove('show'); aqStopPolling(); };
        window.aqCloseChat = function(){ aq$('aqChat').classList.remove('show'); aqStopPolling(); aqCurrentQueryId=null; };

        window.aqSendMessage = function(){
            var inp = aq$('aqMsgInput');
            var msg = inp.value.trim();
            if (!msg) return;
            // If aqCurrentQueryId is 0, we still send (handler will create the row).
            if (aqCurrentQueryId === null) return;
            inp.value = '';
            aqPost('send_message', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId, message:msg }).then(function(r){
                if (r.status==='success'){
                    if (r.created){ aqCurrentQueryId = r.query_id; } // persist the newly created row id
                    aqRenderMessages(r.chats, 'aqChatBody');
                    aqToggleChatActions(r.chats);
                } else if (r.closed){
                    aqCloseQueryUI(r);
                } else {
                    alert(r.message||'Failed');
                }
            }).catch(function(e){
                console.error('Send failed', e);
            });
        };

        // Show Satisfied/Unsatisfied buttons only once staff has replied
        function aqToggleChatActions(chats){
            var hasStaff = (chats||[]).some(function(m){ return m.sent_by === 'staff' && m.type !== 'system'; });
            if (hasStaff && !aqStaffReplied){
                aqStaffReplied = true;
                aq$('aqChatActions').classList.add('show');
            }
        }

        function aqRenderMessages(chats, containerId){
            var c = aq$(containerId);
            c.innerHTML = '';
            if (!chats || !chats.length){
                c.innerHTML = '<div class="aq-empty">Start typing your query. Your manager will reply to you here.</div>';
                return;
            }
            chats.forEach(function(m){
                var b = document.createElement('div');
                b.className = 'aq-bubble ' + (m.type==='system' ? 'sys' : (m.sent_by==='agent' ? 'agent' : 'staff'));
                b.innerHTML = aqEscapeHtml(m.message) + '<span class="meta">' + (m.datetime||'') + '</span>';
                c.appendChild(b);
            });
            c.scrollTop = c.scrollHeight;
            // If rendering in the live chat body, update quick-action visibility
            if (containerId === 'aqChatBody'){
                aqToggleChatActions(chats);
            }
        }

        function aqStartPolling(){
            aqStopPolling();
            aqPollTimer = setInterval(function(){
                if (!aqCurrentQueryId) return; // 0 or null -> nothing to poll yet
                aqPost('fetch_messages', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId }).then(function(r){
                    if (r.status==='success'){
                        aqRenderMessages(r.chats, 'aqChatBody');
                        if (r.status_label !== 'Open'){ aqCloseQueryUI(r); }
                    }
                });
            }, 4000);
        }
        function aqStopPolling(){ if (aqPollTimer){ clearInterval(aqPollTimer); aqPollTimer=null; } }

        function aqCloseQueryUI(r){
            aq$('aqClosedBanner').classList.add('show');
            aq$('aqChatFoot').style.display = 'none';
            aq$('aqChatActions').classList.remove('show');
            aqStopPolling();
        }

        // In-chat status update (Satisfied / Unsatisfied)
        window.aqChatUpdateStatus = function(newStatus){
            if (!aqCurrentQueryId) return;
            if (!confirm('Mark this query as ' + newStatus + '? This will close the query and no further messages can be sent.')) return;
            aqPost('update_status', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId, new_status:newStatus }).then(function(r){
                if (r.status==='success'){
                    aqPost('fetch_messages', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId }).then(function(fr){
                        if (fr.status==='success'){
                            aqRenderMessages(fr.chats, 'aqChatBody');
                        }
                    });
                    aqCloseQueryUI(r);
                } else if (r.closed){
                    aqCloseQueryUI(r);
                } else {
                    alert(r.message||'Failed');
                }
            });
        };

        window.aqOpenPrevQueries = function(){
            aq$('aqLauncher').classList.remove('show');
            aq$('aqCqPanel').classList.remove('show');
            aq$('aqPrev').classList.add('show');
            aqLoadPrevList();
        };
        window.aqClosePrev = function(){
            aq$('aqPrev').classList.remove('show');
            aqStopPrevPolling();
            aq$('aqPrevMsgs').innerHTML = '<div class="aq-prev-placeholder">Select a query from the left to view conversation</div>';
            aq$('aqPrevTitle').textContent = 'Select a query';
            aq$('aqPrevMeta').textContent = '';
            aq$('aqPrevFoot').classList.remove('show');
            aq$('aqPrevClosedBanner').classList.remove('show');
            aqCurrentQueryId = null;
        };

        function aqLoadPrevList(){
            aqPost('list_queries', {}).then(function(r){
                if (r.status!=='success') return;
                var list = aq$('aqPrevList');
                list.innerHTML = '';
                if (!r.queries.length){
                    list.innerHTML = '<div class="aq-empty" style="padding:24px;text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;font-size:.9rem">No previous queries</div>';
                    return;
                }
                var groups = {};
                r.queries.forEach(function(q){
                    var d = (q.last_time||q.created_date||'').slice(0,10);
                    (groups[d] = groups[d]||[]).push(q);
                });
                var dates = Object.keys(groups).sort().reverse();
                dates.forEach(function(d){
                    var g = document.createElement('div');
                    g.className = 'aq-date-group';
                    g.innerHTML = '<div class="aq-date-label">' + aqFormatDateLabel(d) + '</div>';
                    groups[d].forEach(function(q){
                        var item = document.createElement('div');
                        item.className = 'aq-prev-item';
                        item.dataset.qid = q.id;
                        var initials = 'Q' + q.id;
                        var dotColor = '#6366f1';
                        if (q.status === 'Satisfied') dotColor = '#16a34a';
                        else if (q.status === 'Unsatisfied') dotColor = '#dc2626';
                        var actionDot = q.needs_action ? '<span class="aq-action-dot" title="Replied - awaiting your response"></span>' : '';
                        item.innerHTML =
                            '<div class="aq-wa-row">'+
                                '<div class="aq-wa-av" style="background:'+dotColor+'">'+initials+'</div>'+
                                '<div class="aq-wa-content">'+
                                    '<div class="aq-wa-top">'+
                                        '<span class="aq-wa-name">Query #'+q.id+actionDot+'</span>'+
                                        '<span class="aq-wa-time">'+aqFormatTime(q.last_time)+'</span>'+
                                    '</div>'+
                                    '<div class="aq-wa-bottom">'+
                                        '<span class="aq-wa-lastmsg">'+aqEscapeHtml(q.last_msg||'(no messages)')+'</span>'+
                                        '<span class="status-tag aq-st-'+q.status+'">'+q.status+'</span>'+
                                    '</div>'+
                                '</div>'+
                            '</div>';
                        item.onclick = function(){ aqSelectPrevQuery(q.id, item); };
                        g.appendChild(item);
                    });
                    list.appendChild(g);
                });
            });
        }

        function aqSelectPrevQuery(qid, itemEl){
            document.querySelectorAll('.aq-prev-item').forEach(function(e){ e.classList.remove('active'); });
            itemEl.classList.add('active');
            aqCurrentQueryId = qid;
            aqPost('fetch_messages', { query_id:qid }).then(function(r){
                if (r.status!=='success') return;
                aq$('aqPrevTitle').textContent = 'Query #' + qid;
                aq$('aqPrevMeta').textContent = 'Created: ' + (r.created_date||'') + ' • Status: ' + r.status_label;
                aqRenderMessages(r.chats, 'aqPrevMsgs');
                var acts = aq$('aqPrevActions');
                var foot = aq$('aqPrevFoot');
                var banner = aq$('aqPrevClosedBanner');
                if (r.status_label === 'Open'){
                    acts.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('aq-qa-disabled'); });
                    foot.classList.add('show');
                    banner.classList.remove('show');
                    aqStartPrevPolling(qid);
                } else {
                    acts.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.add('aq-qa-disabled'); });
                    foot.classList.remove('show');
                    banner.classList.add('show');
                    aqStopPrevPolling();
                }
            });
        }

        window.aqSendPrevMessage = function(){
            var inp = aq$('aqPrevMsgInput');
            var msg = inp.value.trim();
            if (!msg || !aqCurrentQueryId) return;
            inp.value = '';
            aqPost('send_message', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId, message:msg }).then(function(r){
                if (r.status==='success'){
                    aqRenderMessages(r.chats, 'aqPrevMsgs');
                } else if (r.closed){
                    aq$('aqPrevFoot').classList.remove('show');
                    aq$('aqPrevClosedBanner').classList.add('show');
                    aqStopPrevPolling();
                } else {
                    alert(r.message||'Failed');
                }
            });
        };

        function aqStartPrevPolling(qid){
            aqStopPrevPolling();
            aqPrevPollTimer = setInterval(function(){
                if (aqCurrentQueryId !== qid) return;
                aqPost('fetch_messages', { query_id:qid }).then(function(r){
                    if (r.status==='success'){
                        aqRenderMessages(r.chats, 'aqPrevMsgs');
                        if (r.status_label !== 'Open'){
                            aq$('aqPrevMeta').textContent = 'Created: ' + (r.created_date||'') + ' • Status: ' + r.status_label;
                            aq$('aqPrevActions').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.add('aq-qa-disabled'); });
                            aq$('aqPrevFoot').classList.remove('show');
                            aq$('aqPrevClosedBanner').classList.add('show');
                            aqStopPrevPolling();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, 5000);
        }
        function aqStopPrevPolling(){ if (aqPrevPollTimer){ clearInterval(aqPrevPollTimer); aqPrevPollTimer=null; } }

        window.aqUpdateStatus = function(newStatus){
            if (!aqCurrentQueryId) return;
            if (!confirm('Mark this query as ' + newStatus + '? This will close the query and no further messages can be sent.')) return;
            aqPost('update_status', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId, new_status:newStatus }).then(function(r){
                if (r.status==='success'){
                    aqPost('fetch_messages', { query_id:aqCurrentQueryId }).then(function(fr){
                        if (fr.status==='success'){
                            aqRenderMessages(fr.chats, 'aqPrevMsgs');
                            aq$('aqPrevMeta').textContent = 'Created: ' + (fr.created_date||'') + ' • Status: ' + fr.status_label;
                        }
                    });
                    aq$('aqPrevActions').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.add('aq-qa-disabled'); });
                    aq$('aqPrevFoot').classList.remove('show');
                    aq$('aqPrevClosedBanner').classList.add('show');
                    aqStopPrevPolling();
                    aqLoadPrevList();
                } else if (r.closed){
                    alert('This query is already closed.');
                } else {
                    alert(r.message||'Failed');
                }
            });
        };

        function aqEscapeHtml(t){ if(!t) return ''; return String(t).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#039;'); }
        function aqFormatDateLabel(d){
            if (!d) return '';
            var today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
            var yest = new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
            if (d===today) return 'Today';
            if (d===yest) return 'Yesterday';
            return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
        }
        function aqFormatTime(dt){
            if (!dt) return '';
            try { return new Date(dt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}); } catch(e){ return ''; }
        }

        // Badge: count of Open queries with a real staff reply not yet marked
        function aqRefreshBadge(){
            aqPost('badge_count', {}).then(function(r){
                if (r.status !== 'success') return;
                var badge = aq$('aq-fab-badge');
                if (!badge) return;
                if (r.count > 0){
                    badge.textContent = r.count;
                    badge.classList.add('show');
                } else {
                    badge.classList.remove('show');
                }
            }).catch(function(){});
        }
        aqRefreshBadge();
        setInterval(aqRefreshBadge, 30000);
    })();

    // Copy Public Statement Link Function
    function copyPartnerStatementLink(hashId) {
        const origin = window.location.origin;
        let path = window.location.pathname;
        if (path.includes('/partner')) {
            path = path.substring(0, path.indexOf('/partner'));
        }
        // Ensure no local folder subpath like /travel-portal remains in live or production URLs
        path = path.replace(/\/travel-portal\/?/gi, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
        const fullUrl = `${origin}${path}/statment_foreign_agentAllPublic?id=${hashId}&do=query`;
        
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl).then(() => {
                if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
                    Swal.fire({
                        icon: 'success',
                        title: 'Statement Link Copied!',
                        text: 'Public statement link copied to clipboard.',
                        timer: 2000,
                        showConfirmButton: false
                    });
                } else {
                    alert('Public statement link copied to clipboard:\n' + fullUrl);
                }
            }).catch(() => {
                prompt('Copy this statement link:', fullUrl);
            });
        } else {
            prompt('Copy this statement link:', fullUrl);
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // AI Flight Search Assistant Functions
    // ==========================================
    function openAiFlightModal() {
        var modalEl = document.getElementById('aiFlightSearchModal');
        if (!modalEl) return;
        
        // Try Bootstrap 5 Modal
        if (typeof bootstrap !== 'undefined' && bootstrap.Modal) {
            var bsModal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalEl) || new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl);
            bsModal.show();
        } else if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && typeof $(modalEl).modal === 'function') {
            // Bootstrap 4 fallback
            $(modalEl).modal('show');
        } else {
            modalEl.classList.add('show');
            modalEl.style.display = 'block';
            modalEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
            modalEl.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
        }

        setTimeout(function() {
            var inp = document.getElementById('aiFlightPromptInput');
            if (inp) inp.focus();
        }, 300);
    }

    function setAiFlightPrompt(promptText) {
        var inp = document.getElementById('aiFlightPromptInput');
        if (inp) {
            inp.value = promptText;
            inp.focus();
        }
    }

    function clearAiFlightForm() {
        var inp = document.getElementById('aiFlightPromptInput');
        if (inp) inp.value = '';
        var resSec = document.getElementById('aiFlightResultsSection');
        if (resSec) resSec.style.display = 'none';
        var errSec = document.getElementById('aiFlightErrorState');
        if (errSec) errSec.style.display = 'none';
        var loadSec = document.getElementById('aiFlightLoadingState');
        if (loadSec) loadSec.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Allow Enter key to submit AI flight search (Shift+Enter for newline)
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var textarea = document.getElementById('aiFlightPromptInput');
        if (textarea) {
            textarea.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    triggerAiFlightSearch();
                }
            });
        }
    });

    function triggerAiFlightSearch() {
        var promptInp = document.getElementById('aiFlightPromptInput');
        var query = promptInp ? promptInp.value.trim() : '';

        if (!query) {
            if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
                Swal.fire({
                    icon: 'warning',
                    title: 'Flight details batayein',
                    text: 'Please write where you want to travel, e.g. "Delhi se Jeddah direct flight next Monday"',
                    confirmButtonColor: '#4f46e5'
                });
            } else {
                alert('Please enter your flight requirement (e.g. Delhi se Jeddah next Monday)');
            }
            if (promptInp) promptInp.focus();
            return;
        }

        var btn = document.getElementById('aiFlightSearchBtn');
        var loading = document.getElementById('aiFlightLoadingState');
        var results = document.getElementById('aiFlightResultsSection');
        var errorState = document.getElementById('aiFlightErrorState');
        var errorMsg = document.getElementById('aiFlightErrorMsg');

        // Toggle UI states
        if (btn) {
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm me-2" role="status"></span> Searching...';
        }
        if (loading) loading.style.display = 'block';
        if (results) results.style.display = 'none';
        if (errorState) errorState.style.display = 'none';

        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('flight_query', query);

        // Fetch endpoint
        fetch('ajax_ai_flight_search.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: formData
        })
        .then(function(res) {
            return res.json();
        })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (loading) loading.style.display = 'none';
            if (btn) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<iconify-icon icon="solar:stars-minimalistic-bold-duotone" class="fs-5"></iconify-icon> <span>Search with AI</span>';
            }

            if (data.status === 'success') {
                renderAiFlightResults(data);
            } else {
                if (errorState) {
                    errorState.style.display = 'block';
                    if (errorMsg) errorMsg.textContent = data.message || 'Could not fetch flight recommendations. Please try again.';
                }
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            if (loading) loading.style.display = 'none';
            if (btn) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<iconify-icon icon="solar:stars-minimalistic-bold-duotone" class="fs-5"></iconify-icon> <span>Search with AI</span>';
            }
            if (errorState) {
                errorState.style.display = 'block';
                if (errorMsg) errorMsg.textContent = 'Server error connecting to AI flight engine. Please verify network or try again.';
            }
            console.error('AI Flight Search Error:', err);
        });
    }

    function renderAiFlightResults(data) {
        var results = document.getElementById('aiFlightResultsSection');
        if (!results) return;

        // Populate Understanding Badges
        var u = data.understanding || {};
        var origEl = document.getElementById('aiFlightOrigin');
        var destEl = document.getElementById('aiFlightDest');
        var dateEl = document.getElementById('aiFlightDateBadge');
        var classEl = document.getElementById('aiFlightClassBadge');
        var summaryEl = document.getElementById('aiFlightSummaryMsg');
        var countBadge = document.getElementById('aiFlightCountBadge');

        if (origEl) origEl.textContent = u.origin_city ? (u.origin_city + (u.origin_code ? ' (' + u.origin_code + ')' : '')) : 'Origin';
        if (destEl) destEl.textContent = u.destination_city ? (u.destination_city + (u.destination_code ? ' (' + u.destination_code + ')' : '')) : 'Destination';
        
        var dateText = u.travel_date || 'Upcoming';
        if (u.return_date) {
            dateText = (u.trip_type ? u.trip_type + ': ' : 'Round Trip: ') + dateText + ' ⇄ ' + u.return_date;
        } else if (u.trip_type) {
            dateText = u.trip_type + ' • ' + dateText;
        }
        if (dateEl) dateEl.textContent = dateText;
        if (classEl) classEl.textContent = (u.passengers_count ? u.passengers_count + ' Pax • ' : '') + (u.cabin_class || 'Economy');
        if (summaryEl) summaryEl.textContent = data.summary_message || 'Here are the recommended flight options based on your request.';

        // Populate Flights List
        var flights = data.flights || [];
        if (countBadge) countBadge.textContent = flights.length + (flights.length === 1 ? ' option found' : ' options found');

        var container = document.getElementById('aiFlightCardsContainer');
        if (container) {
            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (flights.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-info rounded-3 text-center py-3">No direct flights matching exactly, or please refine origin/destination in your query.</div>';
            } else {
                flights.forEach(function(fl, idx) {
                    var card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'ai-flight-card mb-3';

                    var badgeColor = fl.badge && fl.badge.toLowerCase().includes('best') ? 'bg-success' : (fl.badge && fl.badge.toLowerCase().includes('cheap') ? 'bg-warning text-dark' : 'bg-primary');
                    var badgeHtml = fl.badge ? '<span class="badge ' + badgeColor + ' rounded-pill px-2 py-1" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;">' + escapeHtml(fl.badge) + '</span>' : '';

                    var mealBadge = fl.meal_included ? '<span class="badge bg-light text-success border"><iconify-icon icon="solar:cup-bold" class="me-1"></iconify-icon>Halal Meal Included</span>' : '<span class="badge bg-light text-muted border">Meals on purchase</span>';
                    var baggageBadge = fl.baggage_allowance ? '<span class="badge bg-light text-dark border"><iconify-icon icon="solar:bag-3-bold" class="me-1"></iconify-icon>' + escapeHtml(fl.baggage_allowance) + '</span>' : '';
                    var refundableBadge = fl.refundable ? '<span class="badge bg-light text-primary border">Refundable</span>' : '<span class="badge bg-light text-muted border">Non-Refundable</span>';
                    var tripTypeBadge = (fl.trip_type === 'Round Trip' || fl.inbound) 
                        ? '<span class="badge rounded-pill bg-indigo-subtle text-primary border border-primary-subtle" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;"><iconify-icon icon="solar:repeat-bold" class="me-1"></iconify-icon>ROUND TRIP</span>'
                        : '<span class="badge rounded-pill bg-light text-secondary border" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;">ONE WAY</span>';

                    // Fare Breakdown text if Round Trip
                    var breakdownHtml = '';
                    if (fl.fare_breakdown) {
                        breakdownHtml = '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;">' +
                            'Dep: <span class="fw-semibold text-dark">' + escapeHtml(fl.fare_breakdown.outbound_fare_inr || '') + '</span> • ' +
                            'Ret: <span class="fw-semibold text-dark">' + escapeHtml(fl.fare_breakdown.return_fare_inr || '') + '</span>' +
                        '</div>';
                    }

                    // Build Outbound Row
                    var out = fl.outbound || {
                        flight_number: fl.flight_number,
                        airline: fl.airline_name,
                        departure_time: fl.departure_time,
                        arrival_time: fl.arrival_time,
                        duration: fl.duration,
                        stops_text: fl.stops_text,
                        origin_city: fl.origin_city,
                        destination_city: fl.destination_city,
                        aircraft: fl.aircraft,
                        travel_date: fl.outbound_date
                    };

                    var outboundHtml = 
                        '<div class="p-2.5 rounded-3 mb-2" style="background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #edf2f7;">' +
                            '<div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between mb-1.5">' +
                                '<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-1.5">' +
                                    '<span class="badge bg-primary text-white" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;">DEPARTURE</span>' +
                                    (out.travel_date ? '<span class="text-muted small fw-semibold" style="font-size:11px;"><iconify-icon icon="solar:calendar-linear"></iconify-icon> ' + escapeHtml(out.travel_date) + '</span>' : '') +
                                    '<span class="text-dark small fw-bold">' + escapeHtml(out.airline || fl.airline_name) + ' (' + escapeHtml(out.flight_number || fl.flight_number || '') + ')</span>' +
                                '</div>' +
                                '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px;">' + escapeHtml(out.aircraft || fl.aircraft || '') + '</span>' +
                            '</div>' +
                            '<div class="row align-items-center g-2">' +
                                '<div class="col-4 text-start">' +
                                    '<div class="fs-5 fw-bold text-dark mb-0">' + escapeHtml(out.departure_time || '--:--') + '</div>' +
                                    '<div class="fw-semibold text-primary" style="font-size:12px;">' + escapeHtml(fl.origin_code || 'Origin') + '</div>' +

                                '</div>' +
                                '<div class="col-4 text-center">' +
                                    '<div class="text-muted small fw-semibold mb-1" style="font-size:11px;">' + escapeHtml(out.duration || '') + '</div>' +
                                    '<div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center position-relative my-1">' +
                                        '<div style="height:2px;background:#cbd5e1;width:100%;"></div>' +
                                        '<iconify-icon icon="solar:plane-bold" class="position-absolute text-primary" style="font-size:15px;background:#f8fafc;padding:0 3px;"></iconify-icon>' +
                                    '</div>' +
                                    '<span class="badge bg-white text-dark border rounded-pill px-2" style="font-size:10px;">' + 
                                        escapeHtml(out.stops_text || 'Non-stop') + 
                                    '</span>' +
                                '</div>' +
                                '<div class="col-4 text-end">' +
                                    '<div class="fs-5 fw-bold text-dark mb-0">' + escapeHtml(out.arrival_time || '--:--') + '</div>' +
                                    '<div class="fw-semibold text-primary" style="font-size:12px;">' + escapeHtml(fl.destination_code || 'Dest') + '</div>' +
                                    '<div class="text-muted text-truncate" style="font-size:11px;" title="' + escapeHtml(out.destination_city || '') + '">' + escapeHtml(out.destination_city || '') + '</div>' +
                                '</div>' +
                            '</div>' +
                        '</div>';

                    // Build Inbound Return Row if Available
                    var inboundHtml = '';
                    if (fl.inbound) {
                        var inb = fl.inbound;
                        inboundHtml = 
                            '<div class="p-2.5 rounded-3 mb-2" style="background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #dcfce7;">' +
                                '<div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between mb-1.5">' +
                                    '<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-1.5">' +
                                        '<span class="badge bg-success text-white" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;">RETURN FLIGHT</span>' +
                                        (inb.travel_date ? '<span class="text-muted small fw-semibold" style="font-size:11px;"><iconify-icon icon="solar:calendar-linear"></iconify-icon> ' + escapeHtml(inb.travel_date) + '</span>' : '') +

                                    '</div>' +
                                    '<div class="col-4 text-center">' +

                                            '<div style="height:2px;background:#86efac;width:100%;"></div>' +

                                        '<div class="fs-5 fw-bold text-dark mb-0">' + escapeHtml(inb.arrival_time || '--:--') + '</div>' +
                                        '<div class="fw-semibold text-success" style="font-size:12px;">' + escapeHtml(fl.origin_code || 'Return Dest') + '</div>' +

                                '</div>' +
                            '</div>';
                    }

                    card.innerHTML = 
                        '<div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center justify-content-between pb-2 mb-2 border-bottom">' +
                            '<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">' +
                                '<div style="width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:#f1f5f9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;color:#334155;font-size:13px;">' +

' (Return Total)' : '') + '</div>' : '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px;">Per Passenger</div>') +

                        '<div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center justify-content-between pt-2 border-top gap-2 mt-1">' +

                                mealBadge +

                            '</div>' +
                        '</div>';

                    container.appendChild(card);
                });
            }
        }

        // Tips List
        var tipsList = document.getElementById('aiFlightTipsList');
        var tipsCard = document.getElementById('aiFlightTipsCard');
        if (tipsList && tipsCard) {
            tipsList.innerHTML = '';
            var tips = data.tips || [];
            if (tips.length > 0) {
                tips.forEach(function(tip) {
                    var li = document.createElement('li');
                    li.textContent = tip;
                    tipsList.appendChild(li);
                });
                tipsCard.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                tipsCard.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        results.style.display = 'block';
        results.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        if (!text) return '';
        var map = {
            '&': '&amp;',
            '<': '&lt;',
            '>': '&gt;',
            '"': '&quot;',
            "'": '&#039;'
        };
        return String(text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) { return map[m]; });
    }
